flows.title: Create a record
steps: Open Quick actions by pressing Cmd+K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows).
Click Add [object] — the object being the record type you want — to create a record without navigating to a specific page.
Include an email for a person, or a domain for a company: this helps Attio prevent duplicates, enrich data, and link people and companies automatically.

flows.title: Create a list
steps: In the sidebar, select the + beside Lists.
Choose whether to start with a template, or click Start from scratch to set up your list manually.
If starting from scratch, choose the object the list will hold (you can only have one object, such as companies or people, per list) and give the list a unique name.
Select a view type to start with, either a table or a kanban view.

flows.title: Log a note on a record
steps: Open the Notes tab on the record's page and click Create note, or press N anywhere in Attio to quickly create a new note.
Write the note in the note editor.
If you want to reference a calendar event, click Link an event beneath the note title.
